note: Fallback people-lines for juice events whose payload carries no line. Short, in-voice, never shaming.

unspoken: Something's different. I can't say what.
letter: A letter came. I read it twice.
rumor: Did you hear? They're saying things again.
Word's travelling. Warm word, for once.
doctrine_voice: The way things are done here, that's the way.
We don't ask. We never did.
doctrine_suppressed: Best keep that one quiet now.
The old words are heavier today.
doctrine_swap: New words in the square. Same hungry faces.
notoriety_rise: People are talking about the one with the full purse.
notoriety_attractor: Strangers on the road. Don't look long.
stash_theft: Did you see? Somebody's been in the cellar.
A door left open. That's all I know.
packet_deliver: Word came from over the hill. Someone there's changed.
News from the next town. Good news, I think.
status_lose: They don't hush for you like they did.
Folk have stopped waiting on your word.
route_break: The road's gone bad. Carts won't chance it.
Nobody's come up that road in days.
stock_deliver: The wagon left sacks at the store. We'll eat.
Supplies came in. The shelves look less sorry.
caravan_arrive: Wagons in the square! Go and see.
The traders are here. Mind your purse.
caravan_trade: They bought what we had spare. Fair enough price.
Some coin changed hands at the wagons.
letter_reply: A reply came back, folded twice.
succession_carried: I'll carry it. I don't know how yet, but I'll carry it.
You kept me warm. Now it's my turn.
succession_rested: They say the fire went out. We'll remember it anyway.
Someone used to come round. Kind, mostly.
legend_heard: There's an old name people say here.
Someone like you came through, long ago.
legend_act: That one's strange. Acts like they've done this before.
Saw the old stranger at it again.
grave_found: There's a new stone on the hill.
Someone's buried up by the wall. Flowers on it.
